dispositions.designConclusion: Affected by consumption. Its adopted block can remain unchanged: equal facts at the same evaluation are retained by one deterministic same-body expansion of the complete shared value. The comparator reads the two wire outputs and performs the closed expansion itself, without importing surface code. A raw inline-property reader is incompatible and must not be treated as the required effective-fact oracle.

dispositions.acceptanceAndLimits: Count the complete actual parity-marker population at the later implementation; compare every field, including closed reason and all route/action metadata, against the same evaluation after the one allowed hop. Reject malformed references before extracting any facts. The 40-fact/13-marker literal proof is bounded design evidence, not that later exhaustive runtime result.
